## Summary

The predicate is `isEnabled()` in `src/lib/feature-flags.ts`. I traced every call site across the repo and excluded:
- **`src/lib/feature-flags.ts`** itself — its internal calls live inside `snapshotFlags()` (builds the precomputed snapshot) and the unused `assertEnabled()` wrapper, not a genuine external caller.
- **`src/components/domain/flags/feature-gate.tsx`** — renders the gate component but delegates entirely to `readFlag()`/the snapshot context, never calling `isEnabled` itself.
- **`src/types/feature-flag.ts`**, **`src/config/feature-flags.ts`** — only mention `isEnabled()` in comments.
- Context-builder-only files (`buildFlagContext`, `orgFlagContext`, `flagContextFor`) don't count on their own, but every file below also contains its own direct `isEnabled(...)` invocation (often as a fallback past a precomputed snapshot: `flags.x === true || isEnabled(...)`), which does count as genuinely asking the predicate.
